posts.text:
Step up.
Lend a hand.

Your actions will inspire others.
Your kindness will spread.
Your generosity will multiply.

We are all connected.
We belong to each other.

In a world where cruelty, indifference, and meanness are too often amplified by algorithms, may we amplify something else.

Compassion.
Grace.
Generosity.
Love.

May we see the good.
May we spread the good.
May we be the good.

op: @secret_nyc

Step up.
Lend a hand.
Reach out.
Offer support.
Acknowledge another.

Our world is full of everyday heroes and humble saints, quietly showing us what goodness looks like.

See them.
Celebrate them.
Be one of them.

Op: @5napclips

There are heroes among us.

People who step up, wade in, and do the unglamorous work of helping, serving, and making a difference.

No spotlight.
No applause.
Just someone seeing a problem and deciding to do something about it.

May we see them.
May we celebrate them.
May we be them.

Op: @pubity

This is huge. 

But may we remember:

Big or small, there is so much power in an unexpected act of kindness.

Amidst the hustle and hurry of our lives, may we look for opportunities to embody this spirit of grace.

To notice.
To reach out.
To lend a hand.

A small act to us can mean the world to someone else.

Op: @cbsnews

Small acts of kindness.
Everyday moments of grace.
The gentle power of a good deed.

Our media may overlook it.
Our algorithms may not amplify it.
But our world is full of this spirit.

See it.
Celebrate it.
Be it.

Op: @tacyaiken_armistead

The quality of mercy is not strain'd.
It droppeth as the gentle rain from heaven
Upon the place beneath. It is twice blest:
It blesseth him that gives and him that takes.

William Shakespeare

Op: @spreadlovemovement_

There is so much power in kindness.

No judgment.
No looking down on others.
No questions asked.

Just an act of grace.
And another.
And another.

Until, perhaps, kindness wears down the stubborn walls of cynicism and reminds us that, despite the loud clang of meanness that captures so much attention, there is still so much goodness in this world.

May we choose kindness.
May we be part of the proof.
